summary: The explicit rank-three projection P_n=R_n R_n^T with rows (1/sqrt(n),sqrt(2/n)cos(2pi k/n),sqrt(2/n)sin(2pi k/n)) has spectrum {1,1,1,0,...}; every exact scalar-sufficient physical bank is a singleton, so every three-bank density-normalized clean scalar core has sigma_min<=3/n. Thus a universal leakage-free three-scalar extraction with core scale c>0 is false. This is not a counterexample to QFORM: for n>=96 the completed diffuse ridge-window theorem gives a continuous density bound <64 on the same family. The missing resource is the within-bank leakage/aggregate curvature, with projection identity EE^T=M-M^2.
